date_seo_1.name: Me
date_seo_1.text: *In front of the fountain. Seoyeon is standing there. Not her usual uniform -- casual clothes. A white blouse and a skirt.*

date_seo_2.name: Me
date_seo_2.text: *She looks like a different person. No -- the same person, just a different side.*

date_seo_compliment_choice.name: Me
choices: You really put in effort today.

date_seo_pretty_high.name: Me
date_seo_pretty_high.text: *Seoyeon pauses for a moment. -- Then she smiles. Not with her lips, but with her eyes.*

date_seo_pretty_high_4.name: Me
date_seo_pretty_high_4.text: *She called me an idiot — but her ears are red. Again.*

date_seo_pretty_low.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_low.text: ...What, all of a sudden. Give a warning before you say things like that.

date_seo_bright.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_bright.text: Of course. I put in some effort today.

date_seo_walk.name: Me
date_seo_walk.text: *We walk through the park. We toss bread to the ducks.*

date_seo_duck.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_duck.text: These guys are so simple. Give them bread and they follow. Don't, and they won't.

date_seo_duck_3.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_duck_3.text: People sometimes won't come even when you give them bread.

date_seo_duck_4.name: Me
date_seo_duck_4.text: *It sounds offhand -- but Seoyeon's own experience bleeds through it.*

date_seo_succulent.name: Me
date_seo_succulent.text: *Seoyeon picks out a small pot. A succulent.*

date_seo_succulent_2.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_succulent_2.text: This one's easy to care for. It survives fine without water.

date_seo_succulent_3.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_succulent_3.text: If you can keep it alive. -- If you can't, I'm taking it back.

date_seo_end.name: Me
date_seo_end.text: *A gift or a test. -- Probably both.*

date_yuna_1.name: Me
date_yuna_1.text: *In front of the cafe. Yuna is leaning against the wall. A black dress and a small crossbody bag.*

date_yuna_2.name: Me
date_yuna_2.text: *Did Yuna always look like this? -- It's my first time seeing her outside of her uniform.*

date_yuna_compliment_choice.name: Me
choices: First time seeing you out of uniform.

date_yuna_pretty_high.name: Me
date_yuna_pretty_high.text: *Yuna pauses for a moment. She lowers her head slightly.*

date_yuna_pretty_high_5.name: Me
date_yuna_pretty_high_5.text: *Again? -- Yuna is asking for a once more.*

date_yuna_pretty_low.name: Yuna
date_yuna_pretty_low.text: ...No one's ever said that to me before.

date_yuna_bookstore.name: Me
date_yuna_bookstore.text: *We head to a bookstore. Yuna walks slowly between the shelves.*

date_yuna_bookstore_3.name: Yuna
date_yuna_bookstore_3.text: ...Good. That means I showed you first.

date_yuna_earphone.name: Me
date_yuna_earphone.text: *Yuna hands me one of her earbuds.*

date_yuna_earphone_3.name: Me
date_yuna_earphone_3.text: *The distance between us is the length of the earphone cord. Thirty centimeters. — Any closer and we touch, any farther and it falls out.*

date_yuna_oldbook.name: Me
date_yuna_oldbook.text: *We pass a secondhand bookshop. Yuna stops walking.*

date_yuna_oldbook_2.name: Yuna
date_yuna_oldbook_2.text: I read this book a year ago. Back then, the ending felt sad.

date_yuna_end.name: Me
date_yuna_end.text: *Yuna looks at me as she says it. -- In her eyes, because of you is written plainly.*

date_dain_1.name: Me
date_dain_1.text: *In front of the gym. Dain comes running over. Cap and sportswear.*

date_dain_2.name: Dain
date_dain_2.text: You're here!! Almost late, weren't you?!

date_dain_3.name: {name}
date_dain_3.text: I got here ten minutes early.

date_dain_4.name: Dain
date_dain_4.text: I was here twenty minutes ago!!

date_dain_pretty_high.name: Me
date_dain_pretty_high.text: *Dain freezes. Her eyes go wide. -- Then she pulls her cap down over her face.*

date_dain_pretty_high_2.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_high_2.text: Hey!! You can't just — say that out of nowhere!!

date_dain_pretty_high_4.name: Me
date_dain_pretty_high_4.text: *She said she'd hit me, but her voice was trembling.*

date_dain_pretty_low.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_low.text: What the — !! ...Haha, thanks, but stop, it's embarrassing.

date_dain_bright.name: Dain
date_dain_bright.text: Obviously!! I'm in peak condition today!!

date_dain_arcade.name: Me
date_dain_arcade.text: *We go to an arcade. We stand in front of a rhythm game.*

date_dain_arcade_2.name: Dain
date_dain_arcade_2.text: Alright, let's make a bet!! Loser buys drinks!!

date_dain_rhythm.name: Dain
date_dain_rhythm.text: Full combo!! Did you see that?!

date_dain_rhythm_3.name: Dain
date_dain_rhythm_3.text: Haha, of course!! This one doesn't need knees!!

date_dain_knee.name: Me
date_dain_knee.text: *Doesn't need knees. -- She said it lightly, but there's weight behind it.*

date_dain_knee_2.name: Me
date_dain_knee_2.text: *We pass a sporting goods store. Dain stops in front of the display window. Volleyball shoes are on display.*

date_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_freetalk.text: *On a date with Seoyeon. She's softer than usual.*
date_seo_freetalk.context: Day 4 date, spending time with Seoyeon. The relationship is deepening. Tone: Conversation has gotten serious. Date excitement and nervousness. More sincerity than jokes. Moments of emotional honesty.
date_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool student council president. During dates, her usual composure wavers and her honest side shows more.

date_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
date_yuna_freetalk.text: *Spending time with Yuna. She's more talkative than usual.*
date_yuna_freetalk.context: Day 4 date, together with Yuna. Her walls have lowered significantly. Tone: Conversation has gotten serious. Date excitement and nervousness. More sincerity than jokes. Moments of emotional honesty.
date_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a mysterious literary girl. During dates, her sentences get longer and emotions show. Two consecutive sentences equal a confession.

date_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
date_dain_freetalk.text: *On a date with Dain. She's more careful than usual.*
date_dain_freetalk.context: Day 4 date, together with Dain. A serious atmosphere mixed in. Tone: Conversation has gotten serious. Date excitement and nervousness. More sincerity than jokes. Moments of emotional honesty.
date_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic athlete. On dates, she's nervous and her volume drops. Exclamation marks disappear when she's genuine.

pre_confess_minsu.name: Minsu
pre_confess_minsu.text: Hey, you're on your date right? Just one thing

pre_confess_minsu_2.name: Minsu
pre_confess_minsu_2.text: Do it right this time. Don't swallow your words

pre_confess_callback.name: Me
pre_confess_callback.text: *The phone in my pocket feels heavy. No notifications. — Like that first day, when I saw a name flash on the screen and shoved it back in. I can't run like that again. Not this time.*
